# Jay Saadana

> Official portfolio of Jay Saadana, a Developer Relations and developer GTM professional working across positioning, technical content, community, partnerships, events, open source, and AI ecosystems.

Jay's work connects technical products with developer audiences across the full go-to-market journey: awareness, education, activation, community, adoption, and advocacy. This site contains his professional experience, selected programs, technical writing, and collaborator testimonials.
